name: Gregory J. Weingart
office: Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division One

items.text: Gregory J. Weingart has been an associate justice of the California Court of Appeal, Second District, Division One, since 2022. He was previously a Superior Court judge, a partner at Munger, Tolles & Olson, and a federal prosecutor leading the Major Frauds section. His appellate opinions include reducing a family judgment by $1.3 billion, deciding jury trial rights for sentencing factors, and reversing rulings on domestic violence restraining orders.
